stock.description: Operating within the People's Republic of China, Lesi Group Limited specializes as a provider of mobile advertising services. The company offers a comprehensive array of solutions to help clients market their brands, products, and services. These services encompass strategic mobile marketing planning, user traffic acquisition, the development of creative ad content, ad placement execution, campaign performance optimization, end-to-end ad campaign management, and broad advertisement distribution. These initiatives are carried out via the media platforms maintained by its network of partners. Founded in 2015, Lesi Group Limited is based in Beijing and was formerly known as Lesi Technology Holdings Limited.
